_comment: Southpaw OS vision settings (Member D). Machine-specific bag corners go in calibration.local.json.

camera._comment: Webcam settings. source: webcam number (0 = /dev/video0) or a video file path.

pose._comment: MediaPipe PoseLandmarker. min_visibility: ignore body points below this (hidden or off-screen).

player._comment: orthodox = left hand leads (jab = left). southpaw = right hand leads.

tracker._comment: smoothing: 0 = none, closer to 1 = smoother but laggier. Distances are in shoulder widths.

punch_detector._comment: A punch starts when the wrist moves faster than min_wrist_speed (shoulder widths per second) while the elbow straightens.

classifier._comment: Rules on the peak pose. Elbow angle: 180 = arm fully straight.

contact._comment: Fist counts as touching the bag if the knuckle point is inside the bag zone (plus margin_px).

output._comment: Where vision events go. Agree host/port with Member C. Use the laptop's IP here if vision runs on the Pi but the hub doesn't (or the reverse).

debug._comment: show_window needs a desktop (Pi Connect). record_path: null = don't record.
